g.text: Note: 29,971 legislator stance records (prompt stance-extraction-0.3-dev) placed on codebook v1.0, House Science and Senate Commerce hearings held 1999-2025. A record is
one member position: cited sentences, an issue, and support or concern. Years are hearing held years; administrations are calendar-year blocks (Bush 2001-2008, Obama
2009-2016, Trump 2017-2020, Biden 2021-2024, Trump 2025). Net stance = (support - concern) / records. Panels are ordered by the absolute change in net stance at each topic's
best single break year, which the panel title reports; x ticks mark inauguration years.
